name: dsh-starter
description: Start the DeepSeek Harness web UI and open it in VS Code's built-in browser.

dsh.mode.description: How to run DeepSeek Harness. 'auto' and 'npm' both run 'npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web'; 'source' runs a local git clone via tsx (set dsh.path).

dsh.browser.description: Which browser to open the UI in. 'built-in' uses VS Code's Simple Browser (falls back to external if disabled); 'external' opens the system browser.

dsh.hideConsole.description: Run the DSH server in a hidden console so neither it nor the tool subprocesses (bash/pwsh) flash a cmd window. Turn off to show it for debugging.

dsh.path.description: Path to the deepseek-harness checkout for 'source' mode (must contain apps/cli/src/bin.ts). Leave empty unless you use source mode.

dsh.nodePath.description: Path to node.exe. Leave empty to use the node on PATH.

dsh.port.description: Port the web UI listens on.

dsh.host.description: Host the web UI listens on.
